mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized growth exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST shows a sustained 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased corporate earnings and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by more than 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where INDPRO increases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than industrial production (INDPRO) over the previous 3 months, it indicates a demand-driven economy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > INDPRO growth in 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS growth exceeds INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases, it signals a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by more than 200k and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in a single month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by more than 0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth exceeds 2% on a quarterly basis and housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% over the same period, it indicates robust economic activity, which is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% and HOUST increases > 5% in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDPC1 growth exceeds 2% and HOUST increases by more than 5%.
